title: Jr KG G
body:
Result
Dear Parents Warm Greetings! We are thrilled to share the results of our Clay Modelling Competition! Our little artists transformed simple clay into wonderful creations, giving shape to their imagination, creativity, and endless possibilities. Their enthusiasm, originality, and artistic expression made the competition truly special. Heartiest Congratulations to Our Winners! First Position: Rudraksh and Adharv Second Position:  Aviraj Third Position: Bhavanya, Tarushi and Hitarth Consolation Prize: Parth A special appreciation to all our young participants for putting their little hearts and hands into creating something beautiful. Every creation reflected a unique idea and deserves a big round of applause! Warm Regards Class Teacher
